items.title: Live: Israeli strikes ignite Iranian gas fields as Albanese says fuel supplies are 'as expected'
items.description: The Israel Defense Forces have been instructed they do not need to seek approval to kill any other senior Iranian official. Follow live.

items.title: Oil tankers 'spoofing' their GPS data to get fuel out of Iran
items.description: Changing flags, creating new names, and faking their GPS data, ABC NEWS Verify investigates how Iranian-linked oil tankers continue to export oil during the war.

items.title: ACCC investigating claims of anti-competitive conduct by fuel suppliers
items.description: The competition watchdog has announced it is investigating allegations of anti-competitive conduct by major fuel suppliers in regional and rural Australia.

items.title: Former climate authority CEO to head new national fuel supply taskforce
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has named Anthea Harris, a former chief of Australia's energy regulator, as the national coordinator of the taskforce.

items.title: Iran in negotiations with FIFA to have US World Cup matches moved
items.description: Iran has no intention of boycotting the FIFA World Cup, but is seeking to have its group stage matches moved out of the United States.

items.title: Australia can't know how Trump plans to end this war
items.description: Even the best minds at Treasury can't know what will happen with global oil supplies, or how Donald Trump plans to end this war, with or without the help of allies.

items.title: Live: Cyclone Narelle intensifies to category five as it closes in on Qld coast
items.description: Severe Tropical Cyclone Narelle has intensified into a category four system, due to make landfall tomorrow. Follow live

items.title: Australia Zoo, government silent in search for captured totemic crocodile
items.description: Missing: One 80-year-old, 4.5 metre totemic crocodile. Last known whereabouts: Australia Zoo. Welcome to the fight for Old Faithful.

items.title: Rohan Dennis's online post described as 'deeply offensive'
items.description: A post shared on Instagram by former professional cyclist Rohan Dennis, whose wife died after being struck by a car he was driving, has been described as "deeply offensive".

items.title: Unemployment rate rises to 4.3pc as full-time jobs decline
items.description: Australia's unemployment rate rose to 4.3 per cent in February, up from 4.1 per cent, in seasonally adjusted terms.

items.title: Jacinta Allan dismisses leadership rumblings as 'scallywag' gossip
items.description: The Victorian premier denounces speculation about her leadership as "scallywag" gossip amid growing concern that she could cost Labor government in November's state election.

items.title: Live: PM says US, Israel's objectives in Iran have been 'secured'
items.description: EU President Ursula von der Leyen will visit Australia next week to meet with the prime minister as Australia inches closer to signing a free trade agreement with Europe. Follow live.

items.title: Sending ship to Strait of Hormuz would test 'small, stretched' Australian navy
items.description: Australia has made it clear it's not planning to send a warship to the Strait of Hormuz and naval experts warn our ships would be of minimal help if they were deployed.

items.title: War drone listings removed from retail platform following ABC investigation
items.description: One-way attack drones described as "cruise missiles" were listed on the popular online retail platform Alibaba for less than $50,000, the ABC has found.

items.title: Red wave expected in SA — but the upper house race is the one to watch
items.description: Labor's popularity in South Australia is set to lead to a large number of seats for the party at the upcoming state election, as various right-wing parties compete for a red seat in the upper house, writes ABC Chief Elections and Data Analyst Casey Briggs.

items.title: 'You had to fight tooth and nail': Women reveal abuse in kava gatherings
items.description: Women in Tongan communities speak out against sexual harassment at social events known as "kava gatherings", where men sit in a circle while a female server pours them the drink, known for its calming effects.

items.title: Ryan Gosling is humanity's last hope in this new space epic
items.description: Project Hail Mary hits Australian cinemas this week, joining Oscar-nominated animation Arco, off-the-wall slasher Dolly and BAFTA-winning biopic I Swear.

items.title: Put your 2026 Oscars knowledge to the test with our Academy Awards quiz
items.description: Awards season might be over for another year but the memories will live on in our minds … and in the questions of this Academy Awards quiz.

items.title: Live: ASX 200 down 1.6 per cent despite surge in energy stocks, brent crude hits $US112 a barrel
items.description: The ASX has been hit with sell-off waves, while oil prices continue to gain. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Middle East war has RBA on high alert for potential economic downturn
items.description: Interest rates, war in the Middle East and AI advancements are expected to hit the Australian economy, but the RBA says we are prepared.

items.title: Bundaberg residents want buyback scheme after three major floods in 15 years
items.description: There are calls for the Queensland government to buy back homes in Bundaberg's flood zones, but the disaster recovery minister says the focus is on mitigation measures like floodgates.

items.title: Bondi lifeguard-turned-police officer makes dramatic surf rescue at Byron Bay
items.description: A former Bondi Rescue reality TV lifeguard who now works as a police officer in Byron Bay jumped into the surf to rescue three French tourists off a rocky headland.

items.title: Driver who killed young motorcyclist was on the phone, judge says
items.description: A driver who has avoided jail after she fatally struck a 21-year-old motorcyclist was under the influence of cannabis and on the phone at the time of the crash south of Adelaide, a judge says.

items.title: Urgent call to ensure all babies are born a healthy weight
items.description: The Productivity Commission's latest Closing the Gap data shows just four out of 19 targets are on track. Advocates call for urgent funding to address low birth weights.

items.title: 'Dire' fortunes of network behind now-defunct Kyle and Jackie O Show
items.description: Even prior to this month's colossal blow-up of the Kyle and Jackie O Show, ARN Media's future had already been teetering on the edge.
